prompt:
Create ONE isolated fantasy game inventory item sprite, named "고블린 곤봉". First reference is ONLY source of monster-specific object design, materials and palette. Second and third references are existing INVENTORY PIXEL ART STYLE examples: match those coarse square pixel clusters and simple stepped dark outlines, broad readable color planes. Do not draw the monster. Goblin club. Reproduce goblin's plain warm-brown wooden club: thick uneven pear-shaped wood head at top, two broad carved wood grain streaks, tapering handle at bottom with beige cloth strips. Very simple crude wooden weapon, no metal spikes, no magic.
LAYOUT: 1024x1536 portrait canvas. Item occupies 2 vertical SQUARE inventory cells in a single column. Keep entire object within central vertical strip width 768 pixels (x=128..896), with 5% padding INSIDE strip. Outside strip fully transparent. Object extends y65..1470; width nowhere exceeds 700px. Critical true item aspect ratio 1:2, not a broad 2:3 object.
STYLE: deliberately low-resolution pixel art, approximately 32 logical square pixels per inventory cell, uniformly enlarged crisp blocks. 3-5 discrete shades per material, dark charcoal-purple outline, pale highlight upper left, no fine microtexture, no smooth gradients, no antialias blur, no photorealism. Preserve large iconic shapes legible at 48px per cell. Transparent RGBA background, alpha zero outside item. No vignette, no glow haze, no shadow under item, no frame, no grid lines, no text, no watermark, no extra unrelated objects. Full intact silhouette with safe margins. Any magic must be solid sharply stepped pixels confined to occupied cells.
